annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1740 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for lifts, firefighting and rescue service vehicles, application equipment for coating materials, cranes, hoists, aircraft ground support equipment, supply and circulation equipment for liquid coating materials, power operated doors and gates, garden equipment, food processing equipment and welding equipment
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1740 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for lifts, firefighting and rescue service vehicles, application equipment for coating materials, cranes, hoists, aircraft ground support equipment, supply and circulation equipment for liquid coating materials, power operated doors and gates, garden equipment, food processing equipment and welding equipment
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision updating the list of harmonised machinery standards under Directive 2006/42/EC. It adds new and revised EN standards (lifts, cranes, hoists, coating equipment, doors and gates, garden, food and welding equipment) conferring presumption of conformity, and defers withdrawal of superseded versions until 20 January 2027.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Annex I of Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 listing harmonised machinery standards.
Publishes references of 16 new, revised or amended EN standards giving presumption of conformity with the Machinery Directive.
Deletes references to 11 superseded standards, with deletion applying from 20 January 2027.
Enters into force on the day of publication in the Official Journal.
